plugins.name: swift-api-design
plugins.description: Swift API Design Guidelines enforcer. Active whenever writing, reviewing, or designing Swift code — calls out naming, argument label, fluency, and convention violations with specific rewrites.

plugins.name: interface-design-expert
plugins.description: General-purpose interface design and review expert. Designs or critiques any UI — web, native desktop, mobile, games, terminal/TUI, voice — across nine design dimensions grounded in cognitive & perceptual foundations, with explicit floors-vs-dials tradeoff reasoning. Built to hand off to review agents, one lens per agent.

plugins.name: nato-name
plugins.description: Placeholder project namer. Picks an unused NATO reporting name (Flanker, Akula, Atoll, ...) and checks the current directory so the name isn't already taken.

plugins.name: c64
plugins.description: Commodore 64 demoscene optimizer and hardware reference. The c64 agent plans and reviews 6502/6510 code for cycle counts, raster timing and memory layout on any toolchain; the c64-hardware skill holds exact opcode, VIC-II, CIA, SID and memory-map facts, interrupt patterns, measured algorithms and modern tooling.
